The Zafira Standard

A Different Reality.

Zafira is not an event company. It is a private, accompanied matchmaking process.

Who We Are

Zafira Match Agency is a private, bilingual matchmaking agency based in Bogotá. We work with men who are seeking a serious relationship and with women who take part voluntarily and free of charge. Every introduction happens only after verification and with the consent of both people.

We do not guarantee a relationship or a marriage. We answer for the judgment behind each introduction: interview, identity, marital status and background checked for both sides.

Our Mission

To introduce people who want a serious relationship, with discretion, verification and personal accompaniment at every step.

Our Vision

To be the most trusted private matchmaking agency between the United States and Latin America, recognised for its judgment and its care for both sides.

Cartagena

Where the in-person programme takes place: October or November 2026, dates to be confirmed.

Verification

Identity, marital status and background checked for both sides before any introduction.

Consent

No introduction happens without both people agreeing, case by case.

Accompaniment

The same matchmaker follows your process from approval to Cartagena.

The Cartagena Programme

A private, accompanied programme in Cartagena: a welcome, organised meetings with the candidates selected for you, cultural activities and a closing dinner. The final agenda, venue and dates are confirmed in writing beforehand.

A Considered Setting

We choose quiet, safe settings so you can focus on the person across from you. Zafira’s team is present throughout the official programme.

“Elegance is found in what is reserved.”

We believe that some experiences are never meant for everyone. True luxury lies in selective access and environments where every detail is carefully considered.

At Zafira, access is intentional. Because we know that the right environment has the power to change a life.

The Philosophy of Zafira
